# Ascendr

Ascendr is a web application for organizing and tracking bouldering competitions. It provides live scoring, real-time leaderboards, analytics, and participant management for climbing events of any size.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ascendr.top/) — Product overview and pricing
- [Privacy Policy](https://ascendr.top/#/en/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://ascendr.top/#/en/terms)
- [Legal Notice](https://ascendr.top/#/en/legal)

## Features

- Real-time leaderboards with Dynamic Pot and Traditional scoring modes
- Zone scoring and attempt penalties
- Judge validation workflows: self-scoring, judge approval, or judge-only
- Participant registration via invite codes or direct links
- Analytics and per-boulder statistics
- White-label branding (Premium plan)
- Multi-language support: English, Spanish, Catalan

## Pricing

- Standard: €129 per event (up to 300 participants)
- Premium: €209 per event (up to 500 participants, white-label branding)
- Extra capacity bundles available at any time

## Contact

Visit [ascendr.top](https://ascendr.top) for more information.
